messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Increased 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (eu-west-1). Service error rate at 28% in last 5m. Autodetecting correlated deploy.

sara-oncall: Noted. I'm paged, starting triage. Has anyone pushed canary in eu-west in last 30m?

mike-sre: yes, a config push to the inference cache layer 29m ago. I'm checking cache invalidation logs.

lee-eng: I'm looking at model routing — we saw new routing rule for dynamic-kv rolled 27m ago. Reverting to previous rule now.

mike-sre: Rolling back routing rule... `curl -X POST https://infra/api/v1/rollbacks -d '{"id":"route-20251114-dynkv"}'`

support-lead: Customer impact: several hosted API customers reporting 503s. Escalated to Sales for the top 5 accounts. Posting list in private thread.

dashboard-bot: Live status update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-11-14 - investigating. (adds incident page)

sara-oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) rollback routing rule (in progress) 2) increase fallback to compact model for eu-west 3) enable rate-limiter to shed heavy prefixes. Executing steps now.

lee-eng: Rollback complete. Observability shows error rate dropping to 12%.

mike-sre: Increased fallback capacity and scaled inference pool +25% in eu-west.

sara-oncall: After scaling + fallback, error rate steadying at 3-4%. Still seeing some spikes for long-context requests.

lee-eng: Deploying a hotfix to guard against missing KV entries that triggered 5xx. Pushing patch to canary.

mike-sre: Canary hotfix looks good for 10min. No 5xx in canary. Scheduling rollout to remaining nodes.

support-lead: Notifying affected customers: initial message sent, we will follow up with ETA for full recovery.

product-ops: Timeline for postmortem? We should aim for an initial incident summary to execs by EOD.

sara-oncall: Agreed. Drafting initial incident summary and action items. Will post here when ready.

dashboard-bot: Status update: INFO - Partial service restored. Users may experience degraded throughput. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-11-14/updates/1

sara-oncall: Summary (initial): Root cause: routing rule rollout that did not account for certain dynamic KV invalidation cases, causing 5xx on cache miss paths. Mitigations: rollback and hotfix. Current status: degraded but stable. Next steps: RCA + code fix + improve pre-deploy checks for routing rules.

lee-eng: Adding unit test and integration test for KV edge cases. Will link PR when ready.

sara-oncall: Closing the incident channel for active remediation; keep threads here for follow-ups. Please pin the status page. :white_check_mark:
